note: Federal Iraq: Iran, Lebanon, Malaysia and Türkiye enter without a visa for 30 days (Lebanon's for travellers under 15 or over 50: not modelled); visa on arrival was suspended on 1 March 2025, and every other nationality applies for the e-Visa (30 days, valid also for the Kurdistan Region). Iraqi Kurdistan's own arrival visa for its List A countries isn't modelled apart (the country is one list). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Iraq
sources.said: Holders of ordinary passports of the following country may enter Iraq without a visa for the following period: 30 days Iran Lebanon Malaysia Turkey ... Since 1 March 2025, the visa on arrival to Federal Iraq has been suspended for 37 countries. The e-Visa system is used instead, and the cost is approximately 160 USD . ... In April 2024, Iraq launched an electronic visa system for visits of 30 days, which is also valid for travel into Iraqi Kurdistan.
